content.comment_body: I want to have [product_name] send data to my server when an input is triggered. Is it possible to use C++ in the PLC?
Check this for reference. It might offer some ideas, but direct C++ coding in [product_name] is not supported. [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking ways to add custom code to [product_name] devices, especially using C++, to achieve additional functions like server communication. The responses indicate such programmability is not supported, showing the device's limitations for user-defined code with standard languages.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to deploy and run C++ code directly on [product_name] PLCs to enable custom server communication.
